description: Transparent, configurable risk rules. The risk level is an application-level triage priority. It is separate from the model's predicted class and from the model's confidence.

PortScan.reason: Port scanning is reconnaissance. It often precedes an attack but has no direct impact on its own.

FTP-Patator.reason: Credential brute-force pattern against FTP. Needs review for account compromise.

SSH-Patator.reason: Credential brute-force pattern against SSH. Needs review for account compromise.

Web Attack - Brute Force.reason: Web login brute-force pattern. Needs review for account compromise.

Web Attack - XSS.reason: Cross-site scripting pattern against a web application.

Web Attack - Sql Injection.reason: SQL injection pattern. Potential data exposure or modification, warrants prompt investigation.

DoS slowloris.reason: Slow denial-of-service pattern that ties up connections at low bandwidth.

DoS Slowhttptest.reason: Slow denial-of-service pattern that ties up connections at low bandwidth.

DoS Hulk.reason: Flood-style denial-of-service pattern with potential availability impact.

DoS GoldenEye.reason: Flood-style denial-of-service pattern with potential availability impact.

DDoS.reason: Distributed denial-of-service pattern with potential availability impact.

Bot.reason: Botnet command-and-control style traffic suggests a possibly compromised host.

Infiltration.reason: Infiltration pattern suggests an internal host may already be compromised. Highest-priority category.

Heartbleed.reason: Heartbleed exploitation pattern can leak server memory including keys. Highest-priority category.

default_rule.reason: The predicted category has no risk rule. A severity is not assigned without evidence, so analyst review is required.

escalations.description: Raise a flood-style DoS/DDoS flow to Critical when the model is confident AND the flow itself shows an extreme packet rate.
